rows.heading: Short Title, Commencement and Scope
rows.quote_snippet: 1.2 It shall apply to all regular executives across all disciplines in Grades E0 through E9 posted across all work centres, plants, basins, offshore installations, and corporate offices of the Corporation.

rows.heading: Short Title, Commencement and Scope
rows.quote_snippet: 1.4 Transfer is an incident of service in ONGC. Every executive is liable to be transferred to any work centre, onshore basin, offshore installation, institute, subsidiary, or joint venture of the Corporation within India or abroad.
